blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Cybercrime Investigation and Coordinating Center (CICC) has given Reddit and Discord 24 hours to establish their presence in the country through a representative amid fatal school shootings that recently occurred. The CICC said on Tuesday it sent two separate letters to the platforms, dated September 21, 2026, to strengthen coordination with Philippine authorities. The agency said that they must adhere to the directive upon receipt of the letters.
